highlights: Prep-to-party coverage, with no fixed hourly time limit
Photo and film together, discounted in Signature Collections
Signature Collections include ten complimentary printed photographs
Destination collections include flights up to £120 per person
Enquiries answered within 24 hours, by form or video call
Suitable replacement provided if either cannot attend through illness

howItWorks.title: Check the date
howItWorks.text: Couples get in touch through the contact form or by arranging a video call to check availability and hear about the collections. Natalie and Max aim to reply within 24 hours.

howItWorks.title: Get to know each other
howItWorks.text: Once the date is confirmed as free, they arrange a phone call or a catch-up by email to make sure they are a good fit for the couple.

howItWorks.title: Secure the date
howItWorks.text: A 30% deposit secures the booking. Couples then receive confirmation of the booking and a wedding guide to help with planning.

howItWorks.title: Share the plans
howItWorks.text: Closer to the day, after meeting their venue or planner, couples complete an online booking form that feeds into a pre-wedding meeting. It is the moment to share any Pinterest ideas.

howItWorks.title: The wedding day
howItWorks.text: They photograph and film until the coverage ends, and check they have captured everything the couple wants before joining them at the bar at the end of the night.

howItWorks.title: Gallery and films
howItWorks.text: Couples usually receive a sneak peek or two first, then the full-resolution photos and the films arrive in a private online gallery.

goodToKnow.text: After the deposit, the remaining balance is invoiced in two equal instalments, and the final payment is due no later than 45 days before the wedding.

If a couple moves their date after paying the deposit and Natalie and Max are free on the new date, a further fee equal to 30% of the package price applies. If they are already booked on the new date, the change is treated as a cancellation.

For destination weddings, flights of up to £120 per person are included, based on travelling the day before and returning the day after; the couple pays any difference. Where a venue abroad is hard to reach by public transport, the couple covers car hire, while the duo cover their own accommodation in the UK and EU unless agreed otherwise in writing.
They ask to be the only professional photographer and videographer at the wedding, unless another arrangement is agreed with them in writing beforehand.
Couples confirm that they and their guests can be photographed and filmed, and should raise any concerns as early as possible.

Natalie and Max keep the copyright and may use wedding images and films for promotion. Couples can print and share their photos and films for personal use, but commercial use needs written agreement in advance.
Consultations take place at their office or online, and the photo and Signature collections include a customised wedding-day timeline. UK collections include travel within a 30-mile radius.
Albums can be ordered with a 10% deposit. After ordering, couples pick their photos through a link and approve a page-by-page layout before the album goes to print.

faqs.a: First they check the date is still free, then they get to know the couple by phone or email. Once both sides agree it is a good fit, they send the details for securing the date with a 30% deposit, followed by a booking confirmation and a wedding guide.

The balance after the deposit is split into two equal instalments, and the final one must be paid no later than 45 days before the wedding. Deposits and instalments are non-refundable if the couple cancels.

faqs.q: What happens if we need to change our wedding date?
faqs.a: They will try to accommodate the new date. If they are free, an extra fee equal to 30% of the package price secures it; if they already have a booking that day, the change counts as a cancellation.

faqs.q: What if the photographer or videographer is ill on the day?
faqs.a: Their terms say that if either cannot attend through illness or other unforeseen circumstances, they will provide a suitable replacement.

faqs.q: Can another photographer or videographer work at our wedding too?
faqs.a: Their terms ask to be the only professional photographer and videographer present, unless agreed with them in writing before the wedding, so any other media professionals should be discussed in advance.

faqs.q: We're not confident in front of the camera. Does that matter?
faqs.a: They say most couples feel the same and expect a few awkward minutes at first, and they guide couples through it. They recommend an engagement session as a chance to get comfortable before the wedding, and suggest booking the hair and make-up trial for the same day.

faqs.q: How will we receive our photos and films?
faqs.a: Everything is uploaded to a password-protected private gallery that the couple and their guests can view, and the password is shared once the upload is complete. Couples can ask for any photos or footage to be removed from the online gallery.

serviceDetails.name: Wedding photography
serviceDetails.more: Their collections page lists the Photo Collection at £2300, with one photographer covering the day from prep to party, five complimentary printed and mounted photographs and travel within a 30-mile radius. The one-to-one consultation can be held at their office or online.

serviceDetails.name: Wedding videography
serviceDetails.more: Their collections page lists the Films Collection at £2200, covering the day from prep to party with one videographer. It includes a one-to-one consultation online or at their office and travel within a 30-mile radius.

serviceDetails.name: Signature Collections (photo and film)
serviceDetails.more: Their collections page describes the Signature Collections as their most popular collections. Both include a highlight video of five to ten minutes, ten complimentary printed photographs and travel within a 30-mile radius.

serviceDetails.name: Destination weddings
serviceDetails.more: Their portfolio features destination weddings at venues including Domaine d'Essendiéras and Chateau Lacanaud in France, Castillo de Viñuelas in Spain, Torre San Marco on Lake Garda and VidaMar in the Algarve. They say they take only a limited number of weddings each year so that every couple gets their undivided attention.

serviceDetails.name: Wedding albums
serviceDetails.more: The Frame, their most popular album, comes in landscape, portrait or square formats in four sizes and can hold anywhere from 40 to 400 photos. The Flush comes in six sizes with a rounded or square spine and an embossed, photo or plain cover, while The Mounted is recommended for 100 to 200 photographs. Their extras list a photo album at £550, and parent albums can be added when ordering.

serviceDetails.name: Engagement shoots and extras
serviceDetails.more: Their collections page lists extras including an additional photographer, drone footage, an engagement shoot and a longer feature film; ask the business for current prices.

notes: All pages fetched 27 Oct 2026. Package and extras prices (£2300, £2200, £4000, £5000 and the extras list) come from the /COLLections/ page, which is publicly reachable but missing from the site's sitemap and reads like a booking-proposal page sent with enquiry replies; the public Investment page publishes only the from-prices (£2,300 photo, £2,200 film), so current figures should be confirmed on enquiry. The collections page shows the Signature Collection twice, once with '10 complimentary printed & mounted photographs' and once with '10 complimentary printed photographs', so 'printed' is used. The 'award winning' and 'featured in top magazines' claims name no award or publication and were not used; the review and magazine counters on the site are unfilled placeholders. Albums carry no individual prices beyond the £550 'Photo Album' extra. The 10% album deposit is shown as a payment option on the Frame, Flush and Mounted order pages. No cancellation terms beyond the non-refundable deposit and instalments were found, and nothing is stated about insurance, power or space needs. The Algarve sister site was not re-read beyond its sitemap. Coordinator removed prices sourced only from the unlisted /COLLections/ page except the published from-prices.
